title: profile-forge config.json
description: Everything is optional. Flags / action inputs override this file; unset keys use the defaults shown.

colors.description: Color overrides. Hex with or without #. bg_gradient is "angle,color1,color2,...".

user.description: GitHub login (the action defaults to the repo owner).

about.description: Paragraphs for the About panel (**bold** markers are stripped).

links.description: Rendered as separate clickable buttons in <output_dir>/buttons/.

timezone.description: IANA zone that decides what "today" is for streaks.

themes.description: A list of theme names, or { slot: theme }. A slot decides the file name (profile-forge-<slot>.svg), so { "dark": "dracula", "light": "gruvbox-light" } keeps the README <picture> unchanged.

customThemes.description: Your own themes: { name: { base: <theme>, ...color overrides } }, usable in `themes`.

panels.description: The shape of the panels: rounded, square, notched (chamfered corners and an accent stroke, like a game HUD) or pop (a thick outline and a hard offset shadow, like a comic panel).

titles.description: The title of each panel: plain text, or a label in the accent colour with a slanted end.

patternColor.description: Colour of the pattern (the muted colour of the theme by default).

patternOpacity.description: Opacity of the pattern (each pattern has its own default).

patternSize.description: Scale of the pattern, in percent.

glowColor.description: Colour of the glow (the ring colour of the theme by default).

glowX.description: Where the glow is centred, in percent of the card width.

glowY.description: Where the glow is centred, in percent of the card height.

glowSize.description: Radius of the glow, in percent of the card width.

image.description: An image (svg, png, jpg, webp, gif) behind everything, relative to config.json; it is embedded in the card.

decor.description: Art on the card: motifs of the library or your own images. Position and size are percents of the card width.

image.description: Path of an image relative to config.json, instead of a motif.

text.description: A word on the card (a comic caption), instead of a motif or an image; color is its fill, color2 its outline.

y.description: In percent of the card width, from the top (or from the bottom with anchor: bottom).

speed.description: Pace of an animated piece (the lightning motif, or an animated svg of yours): 1 is the original, 2 twice as fast.

layout.description: Section order. A nested pair puts two sections side by side at half width (any two except header).

grid.description: Free layout on a 6-column grid instead of `layout`: each section has a width in columns and falls to the lowest free spot. The height follows the content. Minimum widths: header 6, stats/streak/languages/heatmap 3, the others 2. The optional height can only make a card taller than its content.

height.description: Card height in pixels. Never shorter than the content needs; omit for automatic.

frame.description: A decoration around the avatar, like Discord avatar decorations. ring: the classic gradient ring. auto: follows the level (E none, D ring, C double, B dashed, A neon, S stars, SSS halo, X aurora). Colour: colors.frameColor, default the level colour.

flag.description: Path of a flag image (svg/png, 4:3) drawn under the name, e.g. assets/img/flags/it.svg.

rankEffect.description: The effect around the rank. auto: by level (S- to S+ a halo, SSS a running light and sparkles, X glowing embers). none, halo, shine, embers or rainbow pick one by hand at any level.

rankStyle.description: The shape of the rank indicator.

frameAnimation.description: default: the frame's own motion. none: still. spin / pulse / twinkle: override it where it makes sense.

hide.description: Case, - _ and spaces are ignored at runtime (e.g. pull-requests).

commitsYear.description: Count commits of this year only.

dateFormat.description: PHP-style (d j m n M F y Y); text in [...] is hidden for the current year, e.g. "M j[, Y]".

count.description: Charts (donut/pie) show at most 10 in the legend.

titles.description: Only these trophies (aliases: Star, Commit, Follower, Issue, PR, Repo, Review, Duration, Orgs...).

ranks.description: Only these ranks (E, E+, D-, D … S+, SSS, SECRET; a bare letter means its whole family). A "-" prefix drops one, e.g. -E.

padding.description: Space between the panel edge and the trophies.

parts.description: Which texts and the progress bar to show on each trophy.

order.description: These trophies come first, in this order; the others follow. Unlike `titles` it hides nothing.

extra.description: No longer used: Issues and Reviews are shown like the other trophies. Ignored.

birthday.description: Your birthday as MM-DD (or YYYY-MM-DD): the Happy Birthday secret trophy shows on that day, in the card's time zone.

sort.description: default: the order of `titles` (or the built-in order). rank: highest level first, secret trophies after. name: A-Z.

highlight.description: Trophy titles drawn with a pulsing glow.

marquee.description: The Tech stack section: scrolling logos.

rows.description: Rows of logos, scrolling in alternating directions.

order.description: shuffle: random at every generation. config: as listed. name: A-Z.

byCategory.description: Order / shuffle inside each category and keep the categories in sequence, instead of mixing everything.

terminal.description: A terminal window: lines starting with "$ " are typed like commands, the others appear as their output.

orgs.description: The organizations you contributed to (commits, PRs, issues, reviews, all years), as chips with their logo.

select.description: Only these organizations (logins). Empty: all of them, new ones too.

hide.description: Organizations not to show; every other one is shown, new ones too.

order.description: The order for sort "custom": these first, the others after by contributions.

sort.description: contributions: most contributions first. popularity: most stars (of the repos you contributed to) first. custom: the order of `order` (or of select).

mode.description: static: chips in rows. scroll: one row that keeps moving.

direction.description: Where the row moves in scroll mode.

speed.description: Pixels per second in scroll mode.

rhythm.description: When you code: average contributions per weekday and total per month, last 12 months.

mode.description: grid: the plain contribution grid. snake: an animated snake eats the contributions (loops forever, plain CSS). pacman: an automatic game of Pac-Man with the four ghosts, played on the cells.

pacmanMaze.description: The maze of the pacman mode. data: the quiet days become walls (the maze changes with your data, every cell stays reachable). classic: a fixed arcade-style maze. open: no walls.

pacmanLives.description: Lives of Pac-Man in the pacman mode.

pacmanGames.description: Games played one after the other before the loop restarts (the high score carries over).

snakeLength.description: How many cells long the snake is.

snakeStyle.description: classic: the snake colour. rainbow: every segment its own colour. glow: a soft halo around the body.

snakePath.description: Route of the snake. smart: quietest days first, then busier ones. busy: busiest first. nearest: always the closest day. sweep: column by column. rows: row by row. spiral: outside in.

cell.description: Shape of a day. triangle: alternating up / down. hexagon: a honeycomb. snowflake: more contributions, brighter flake. moon: phases from empty to full by contributions. mixed: a random mix of square, round and triangle.
